faq.q: How much does Kurt T. Richards charge?
faq.a: Kurt T. Richards publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Kurt T. Richards offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Kurt T. Richards publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Kurt T. Richards have offices?
faq.a: Kurt T. Richards publishes one office, in Staten Island. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Kurt T. Richards?
faq.a: Kurt T. Richards names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.
